entities.summary: Richell Bonner, better known as Richie Spice, is a Jamaican reggae artist. He is a member of the Rastafari movement. Some of his most famous songs include, "Brown Skin", "Youth Dem Cold Rel Bad", "Grooving' My Girl", "Earth a Run Red", "Marijuana" ,"The Plane Land" and "King and Queen". Three of his brothers are also reggae artists – Pliers, Spanner Banner and Snatcha Lion.
